text.en:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Arms (Amendment of citation.
Second Schedule) Regulations 1989.
text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Mesin Cetak dan Nama.
Penerbitan (Kawalan Hasil Penerbitan Yang Tak Diingini) 1989.

text.en:
2. The Second Schedule to the Arms Act 1960 is amended by Amendment
inserting after subparagraph (g) of paragraph 2, the following new  Baa
subparagraph (h):

"(h) For any or all air guns, air pistols, revolvers, rifles of any
calibre and any other type of arms (including smooth
bore shotguns) licensed to specified security agency and
are used solely for security and protection purposes
provided that the permit holder may carry and use not
more than ten of any of the said arms at anytime

... $100",

Made the 1st March 1989.
[KDN. (S) 21/59; PN. (PU') 251.]

Dato' Megat Junid BIN Megat Ayo,
Deputy Minister of Home Affairs
